body_text:
Let $H$ be a subgroup of a group $G$. For $g\in G$, the left
coset $gH$ is $\{gh:h\in H\}$ and the right coset $Hg$ is
$\{hg:h\in H\}$. Left cosets form a partition of $G$: two left
cosets are either equal or disjoint, and every element lies in
the coset it determines. The analogous statement holds for
right cosets.
